channel.title: Eastern Daily Press - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Eastern Daily Press (edp24.co.uk)

item.title: Sex pest scandal sees law firm's senior partner suspended over office party comments
item.description: Timothy Eagle, a former senior partner at Hansells Solicitors in Norwich, has been suspended for making sexual comments to multiple women at a Christmas party.

item.title: Norwich's most-closed road? Anger as road closures cause traffic chaos
item.description: People living near Yarmouth Road, which has been closed nine times in the last year, have spoken out over the chaos the closures cause in their neighbourhood.

item.title: War hammer-armed burglar jailed for attack that knocked woman unconscious
item.description: Billy Morris pushed the woman into a glass door and repeatedly slammed the woman’s head into the floor during a prolonged attack.

item.title: Boaters hit with £41,000 fines over unpaid toll fees
item.description: Boaters in the Norfolk Broads have been hit with fines totalling £41,000 for unpaid toll fees after officials took 35 people to court in the past four weeks.

item.title: 'Dungeon' warehouse gets permission for major renovation
item.description: Planners for Norwich City Council have approved plans for a refurbishment at a warehouse on Whiffler Road.

item.title: Plans revealed for new supermarket and cafes at site near major road
item.description: Developers have put forward an application to build a Sainsbury's supermarket, three cafes and a solar park on land adjacent to McDonald's in Blofield.

item.title: Hunt continues for burglars who broke into homes through their back doors
item.description: Detectives have exhausted two out of three investigations into burglaries on the outskirts of the city.

item.title: REVEALED: The most crime-hit streets in scenic towns revealed
item.description: Beccles and Bungay's most crime-hit streets in 2025 have been revelled, with figures showing where offending is most concentrated.

item.title: Thief appears in court for ransacking £1,100 of meat from farm shop
item.description: Glenn Miller, of Marine Parade in Great Yarmouth, has been charged with stealing £1,100 worth of meat from Upper Wood Farm Shop in Mautby.

item.title: 10-mile diversion as village road to shut next month for bridge repairs
item.description: Motorists have been warned of disruption as a Norfolk village road will close next month.
